data.name: Are you sure you want to delete this distribution channel?
data.value: Er du sikker på, at du vil slette denne distributionskanal?

data.name: Deletion permanently removes this channel, its unused coupons and all user bindings. This cannot be undone.
data.value: Sletning fjerner permanent denne kanal, dens ubrugte kuponer og alle brugerbindinger. Dette kan ikke fortrydes.

data.name: Keep this channel for reference. Disable it from the channel details page to stop future coupon use while preserving history.
data.value: Bevar denne kanal som reference. Deaktiver den fra kanalens detaljeside for at stoppe fremtidig kuponbrug, mens historikken bevares.

data.name: This action cannot be undone. All associated user bindings will also be deleted.
data.value: Denne handling kan ikke fortrydes. Alle tilknyttede brugerbindinger slettes også.
